div.span: Automate Dimonas to avoid missing deadlines, by

group.div:
You must declare every employee start date before or by the first working day to the ONSS.
Then, changes on the start or end date must be reported too. Failure to do so
can lead to fines, or scrutiny from the social-security inspectorates.

You must declare the departure of an employee to the ONSS, at the latest on the first
working day following the end of the employment. Failure to do so can lead to fines,
or scrutiny from the social-security inspectorates.

The data declared for this employee changed. Any change on the start or end date
(and on the planned hours for a student) must be reported to the ONSS. Failure to do so
can lead to fines, or scrutiny from the social-security inspectorates.

This employee never started working. The declaration sent for them must be cancelled
with the ONSS, otherwise they stay registered as one of your employees. Failure to do so
can lead to fines, or scrutiny from the social-security inspectorates.

The last declaration sent for this employee was refused by the ONSS because of blocking
anomalies, listed in the employee chatter. It must be corrected and declared again,
otherwise this employee is not declared to the ONSS.

To do it manually:
Fill the form on
SocialSecurity.be
Mark as submitted in Odoo
